payment_terms.value_text: Payment must be made no later than 30 days from the date of submission of the Stage Payment Statement to the Authority's Engineer.
payment_terms.quote: Payment shall be made no later than 30 (thirty) days from the date of submission of the Stage Payment Statement by the Contractor to the Authority’s Engineer for certification in accordance with the provisions of Clause 17.4
payment_terms.notes: Clause 17.5.1 provides for an advance release of 90% part payment within 10 days of the Authority receiving the AE's recommendation (which itself takes up to 10 days). Clause 17.7.1(b) specifies 30 days for payment against the Final Payment Certificate. Clause 17.7.2 specifies interest on delayed payment at Bank Rate plus 3% calculated at quarterly rests.
payment_terms.reasoning: Page 77 (Clause 17.7.1(a)) specifies that payment shall be made no later than 30 days from the date of submission of the Stage Payment Statement by the Contractor to the Authority's Engineer. Page 76 (Clause 17.5.1) also provides that the Authority shall pay 90% part payment within 10 days of receiving the Authority Engineer's recommendation (which is issued within 10 days of receipt of the statement). Clause 17.7.1(a) represents the definitive overall timeline for paying interim bills and is selected as the primary value.

retention.value_text: 6% deducted from every payment for Works, capped at 5% of the Contract Price
retention.quote: the Authority shall deduct 6% (six per cent) thereof as guarantee money for performance of the obligations of the Contractor during the Construction Period (the “Retention Money”) subject to the condition that the maximum amount of Retention Money shall not exceed 5% (five per cent) of the Contract Price.
retention.notes: Clause 7.5.3 allows the Contractor to replace deducted Retention Money with a bank guarantee in tranches of not less than 1% of Contract Price. Clause 7.5.4 provides for release/refund within 15 days of the issue of the Completion Certificate.
retention.reasoning: Clause 7.5.1 on page 39 explicitly states that the Authority will deduct 6% from each payment for Works as guarantee money/Retention Money during the Construction Period, with an overall maximum cap of 5% of the Contract Price. Clause 7.5.4 on page 40 notes that the balance is refunded within 15 days of the issue of the Completion Certificate. No conflicting terms appear in the other excerpts.

advance.value_text: The advance payment is 10% of the Contract Price for mobilisation expenses and acquisition of equipment.
advance.quote:
The Authority shall make an advance payment (the “Advance Payment”), equal to
10% (ten per cent)7 of the Contract Price, for mobilisation expenses and for acquisition
of equipment.
advance.notes: Advance payment carries simple interest at 8% per annum and is disbursed in two equal instalments against bank guarantees of 110% of each instalment value. Deductions commence when cumulative payments reach 50% of Contract Price, capped at 30% of each Interim Payment Certificate, and must be fully recovered before payments exceed 90% of Contract Price. Annex-III (page 160) standard form text conflicts by mentioning an interest-free advance in three instalments.
advance.reasoning: Clause 17.2.1 on page 74 specifies that the Authority shall make an advance payment equal to 10% of the Contract Price for mobilisation expenses and equipment acquisition, payable in two equal instalments with simple interest at 8% per annum. While the bank guarantee form template in Annex-III of Schedule-F on page 160 refers to an interest-free advance in three instalments under a misnumbered Clause 19.2, Clause 17.2 represents the governing operative provision. Recovery mechanics are detailed in Clause 17.2.5 on page 75.

escalation.value_text: Contract price is adjusted using index-based price adjustment formulas with specified component weightings
escalation.quote: The following percentages shall govern the price adjustment of the Contract Price:
escalation.notes: Price adjustment applies based on a formula using CPI and WPI indices with component percentages for labour, cement, steel, bitumen, fuel, other materials, and plant/machinery. Per subclause (f), no price adjustment applies to an IPC relating to a month within 3 months from the Base Date.
escalation.reasoning: Page 6 lists Clause 17.8 ('Price adjustment for Works') and Clause 17.9 ('Restrictions on price adjustment'). Page 80 provides the price adjustment mechanism, including index definitions (CPI and WPI) and component percentages governing price adjustment of the Contract Price, followed by restrictions under Clause 17.9. There are no conflicts; price adjustment is governed by a formula rather than a single fixed percentage.

performance_security.quote: an irrevocable and unconditional guarantee, for an amount equal to 5% (five per cent) of the Contract Price, from a Bank in the form set forth in Annex-I of Schedule-F (the “Performance Security”).
performance_security.notes: Must be provided as a bank guarantee within 15 days of the Agreement date. Validity must extend until 60 days after the expiry of the Defects Liability Period (Clause 7.2 allows initial provision for 2 years with required extension). Clause 7.1.1 also requires a separate Performance Security equal to 5% of the estimated cost of Structures and Major Bridges for the extended DLP.
performance_security.reasoning: Article 7 (Clause 7.1.1) on page 38 clearly specifies that the Contractor must provide an irrevocable and unconditional bank guarantee for an amount equal to 5% of the Contract Price as Performance Security. Clause 7.1.1 on page 38 also specifies an additional Performance Security of 5% of the estimated cost of Structures and Major Bridges for the extended Defects Liability Period, while Clause 7.5.1 on page 39 mentions Retention Money capped at 5% of the Contract Price. There are no conflicts regarding the primary Performance Security rate of 5% of the Contract Price.
